semiconductor_relevance: High — Cadence Design Systems provides essential electronic design automation tools that are critical for semiconductor design and optimization.
summary: Cadence Design Systems offers a comprehensive design environment that integrates digital and analog IC design with packaging and PCB design. Their Integrity™ 3D-IC Platform enables significant optimization of 3D-ICs through advanced design and analysis capabilities, enhanced by AI technologies.
capabilities: Integrity™ 3D-IC Platform for integrated design and analysis
Pro-planning and system analysis for 2.5D/3D package design
Power, thermal, and timing analysis for early design quality improvement
Collaborative design tools including Innovus™, Virtuoso®, and Allegro®
technical_expertise: Heterogeneous integration of multiple process nodes

regional_presence.Japan: Cadence has a presence in Japan, focusing on providing design solutions tailored to the local semiconductor market.
